# 覆盖 AUTO-GENERATED skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect
# 逐 stack：先扩编同类型常备，再 personal create，再尝试 title:h_china / e_great_liao 头衔兵

skonester_sand_try_add_one_maa_stack_effect = {
  remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
  set_variable = {
    name = skonester_sand_spawn_iter_before
    value = maa_regiments_count
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      any_maa_regiment = {
        is_maa_type = $TYPE$
        can_upgrade_maa = yes
      }
    }
    random_maa_regiment = {
      limit = {
        is_maa_type = $TYPE$
        can_upgrade_maa = yes
      }
      change_maa_regiment_size = {
        size = 1
        reinforce = yes
      }
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
      value = 1
    }
  }
  else = {
    create_maa_regiment = {
      type = $TYPE$
      check_can_recruit = no
      size = 1
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        maa_regiments_count > var:skonester_sand_spawn_iter_before
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
        value = 1
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        has_title = title:h_china
      }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        title = title:h_china
        size = 1
      }
      if = {
        limit = {
          maa_regiments_count > var:skonester_sand_spawn_iter_before
        }
        set_variable = {
          name = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
          value = 1
        }
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        has_title = title:e_great_liao
      }
      create_maa_regiment = {
        type = $TYPE$
        check_can_recruit = no
        title = title:e_great_liao
        size = 1
      }
      if = {
        limit = {
          maa_regiments_count > var:skonester_sand_spawn_iter_before
        }
        set_variable = {
          name = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
          value = 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_iter_before
}

skonester_sand_spawn_maa_at_staged_scale_effect = {
  remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_ok
  remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_stacks_added
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_variable = skonester_sand_staged_scale
      var:skonester_sand_staged_scale >= 1
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = skonester_sand_spawn_add_left
      value = var:skonester_sand_staged_scale
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = skonester_sand_spawn_stacks_added
      value = 0
    }
    while = {
      limit = {
        var:skonester_sand_spawn_add_left > 0
      }
      skonester_sand_try_add_one_maa_stack_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
      if = {
        limit = {
          has_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
        }
        remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_stack_ok
        change_variable = {
          name = skonester_sand_spawn_add_left
          subtract = 1
        }
        change_variable = {
          name = skonester_sand_spawn_stacks_added
          add = 1
        }
      }
      else = {
        set_variable = {
          name = skonester_sand_spawn_add_left
          value = 0
        }
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        var:skonester_sand_spawn_add_left = 0
        var:skonester_sand_spawn_stacks_added >= 1
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = skonester_sand_spawn_ok
        value = 1
      }
    }
    remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_add_left
    remove_variable = skonester_sand_spawn_stacks_added
  }
}
